heroHeadline: Day 682: 90 Murciélagos Special Forces Airlifted to Culiacán After 30 Dead in 72 Hours; Defense Secretary and National Guard Commander Conduct Emergency Supervisory Visit; FGR Contradicts Sheinbaum on Interpol Red Notice for Rocha Moya
heroSubtitle: 682 days of cartel civil war — June 3–5, 2026: A violent surge in Culiacán (10 homicides June 3; 30 killed in 72 hours) prompted the Army to airlift 90 elite Murciélagos special forces from Santa Lucía air base to Culiacán — the highest operational intensity since October 2024. Defense Secretary Ricardo Trevilla Trejo and National Guard Commander Guillermo Briseño Lobera flew to Culiacán on June 4 for an emergency supervisory visit to 'strengthen capabilities and inhibit violence.' On June 5, Mexico's FGR contradicted President Sheinbaum's own May 21 statement: Attorney General spokesperson Ulises Lara López said Rocha Moya has no active Interpol Red Notice; García Harfuch said authorities are 'only aware of a US arrest warrant' — creating credibility confusion over the case against the SDNY-indicted governor. Separately: Mazatlán Chapitos plaza boss 'Gabito 80' (Óscar Gabriel Larios) arrested June 1 — linked to murder of 6 mining workers. El Chinacate at Altiplano (~22 days on US extradition deadline). Summer calendar: El Mayo EDNY July 20, Ovidio NDIL July 27, Joaquín NDIL Aug 31. La Mayiza ~90% territorial control; 13,300+ federal troops under interim Governor Bonilla Valverde. Running toll: ~2,560+ homicides (Noroeste) / 3,000+ (WSJ) since September 9, 2024; ~5,800 disappearances (NGO Sabuesos Unidas AC).
